dedupe_keys.name: mfem mgis nuclear fuel thermomechanics coupling

description: MFEM/MGIS connects MFEM finite-element calculations with MGIS material-behaviour laws in a high-performance mini-application. The JOSS article applies this coupling to nonlinear thermomechanical simulations of nuclear fuel at mesoscale, and the own repository offers a beam tutorial, installation instructions and example meshes. Spatial coverage is the supplied fuel or material mesh, while temporal coverage is the simulated loading history; it is not a database of operating reactors. The repository metadata gives LGPL-3.0. Researchers can use this coupling to test material response assumptions that feed reactor-fuel safety simulations. A caveat is that the result depends on constitutive laws, boundary conditions, mesh quality and solver settings. A mesoscale calculation alone does not establish plant-level safety or licensing compliance. No matching catalogue or first-review resource was found. The article, repository and linked documentation were inspected without compiling the solver or running an example.
